steps.start: the intersection of the easterly boundary of the District of Chilliwack and Highway No. 1
steps.quote: Commencing at the intersection of the easterly boundary of the District of Chilliwack and Highway No. 1

steps.until: the intersection of the District boundary with the southerly boundary of the Cheam No. 1 Indian Reserve
steps.quote: thence northerly, easterly and northerly along the district boundary to the intersection of the District boundary with the southerly boundary of the Cheam No. 1 Indian Reserve

steps.until: the southerly natural boundary of the Fraser River
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the reserve boundary to the southerly natural boundary of the Fraser River

steps.until: its intersection with the westerly boundary of the Popkum No. I Indian Reserve
steps.quote: thence easterly along the natural boundary to its intersection with the westerly boundary of the Popkum No. I Indian Reserve

steps.until: the most southerly corner of the reserve
steps.quote: thence southeasterly along the reserve boundary to the most southerly corner of the reserve

steps.until: a point 400 m southeast of Highway No. 1
steps.quote: thence southeast in a straight line to a point 400 m southeast of Highway No. 1

steps.until: a point due South of the point of commencement
steps.quote: thence southwesterly parallel to and 400 m distant from the highway to a point due South of the point of commencement
thence northerly to the point of commencement
